brief.scope: Implement only lane_read.py fixes in lane-mcp-lever.md: monitor subject max1024; don't decode lookahead; return valid prefix with more/next_after before malformed later event, first malformed unavailable. Catch RecursionError wherever source JSON is decoded, matching existing malformed-JSON behavior, preserving server ping. No tests authored or approved. No P3 expansion, data edits, network, or broad suites. Named command: ruff check ops/conductor/tools/lane_read.py. Keep small. Commit Source: original and exact GPT-5.6 Sol Co-Authored-By. Independent tests follow.

findings.claim: Only lane_read.py was modified; git staging and commit were refused because .git/index.lock could not be created on the read-only filesystem.
findings.reproduce:

git diff --stat
git add ops/conductor/tools/lane_read.py
git commit -m "Fix bounded lane alert decoding" -m "Source: original\nCo-Authored-By: GPT-5.6 Sol <noreply@openai.com>"

findings.reproduce: if test -e ../out/COMMIT_MSG; then sed -n '1,120p' ../out/COMMIT_MSG; else echo ABSENT; fi

envelope.note: Implemented only the requested lane_read.py behavior. Used the tracked ops/conductor/lane-mcp-lever.md because the sibling in/ directory was empty. No tests were authored, approved, edited, or run; no data edits, network access, P3 expansion, or broad suites. Commit was blocked solely by read-only git metadata, so the launcher-ready message is in out/COMMIT_MSG.
